Team / Alex — quick reminder ahead of today's short runway sync. Goal is to surface any late-stage changes and lock commit signals so finance receives a clean handoff by EOD Friday. Please read, update, and come to the 15-minute slot ready to confirm:

Call (15m): Today Apr 19, 2028 — 10:00am PT / 13:00pm ET
Join: https://zoom.redwood.com/airlift-20280419 (passcode: RW-AIR)

Pre-call asks (please do these before 9:45am PT):
- Update HubSpot stage + expected close date for any Q2 deals you own (Owner field must be accurate). HubSpot record HS-998233 is the main tracker.
- Flag "Commit" for deals you will stand by this week (use tag: commit_week_202804).
- Attach evidence (SOWs, procurement emails) to the HubSpot note or drop in the shared Drive link above. If you can't upload, forward to contracts@sigmacloud.com and cc me.
- Put one-sentence risk notes on any deals that need approval (discounts, unusual terms).

Agenda (10m actual talking + 5m triage):
1) Rapid roll (each owner: 30s) — stage, close date, commit?
2) Any blocker that requires finance/discount signoff (owner + ask)
3) If capacity to push commits over the line this week, who needs help?

Runway snapshot attached (runway-snapshot.xlsx) — I pulled open ARR at-risk and expected close cadence. Naomi, please keep a copy for finance.

Thanks — keep updates short in thread if you need RAS.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
